name: search_experience
description: Search this repository's evidence-backed experience-recall index for prior work relevant to a natural-language query — returns the ranked, trust-classified record set (record ids, kind, trust, spec/scope anchors, freshness) emitted by the experience-recall.sh bash twin. READ-ONLY: this tool adds NO scoring, NO freshness computation, and NO source validation of its own; it shells out to the twin and returns its stdout/stderr/exit code verbatim, so the CLI and MCP surfaces can never disagree. IMPORTANT — an empty result is AMBIGUOUS: when the repo's experience-recall adapter is disabled (adapter=none) the twin still exits 0 and prints an empty array, which is indistinguishable from a healthy index with no matches. Call `experience_recall_status` to tell 'recall is off' apart from 'recall is on and found nothing'. Use `read_experience` to pull one record's full body. The twin's filter flags (--kind/--trust/--spec-ref/--scope-ref) and every mutating subcommand (sync, admit, delete, lifecycle, export) are deliberately CLI-only and are NOT reachable from MCP.

query.description: Natural-language query text, e.g. 'flaky e2e login redirect'. Must not begin with '--'.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-20). Matches the twin's own bound.

format.description: Output format. Defaults to json (the machine-readable record payload). Use text for the human-readable rendering.
